item.title: Ethiopian Nibret Melak wins Dubai Marathon 2026
item.description: Ethiopian athletes dominated the 25th Dubai Marathon, with Nibret Melak winning the men's race in 2:04:00, surpassing last year's champion by 50 seconds. Anchinalu Dessie triumphed in the women's category, setting a personal best of 2:18:31. This marks the fourth consecutive year Ethiopians have claimed victory in both categories, highlighting their prowess in long-distance running.
